(allowance 0/9) a.Joinery: windows, doors, stairs, podiums.b.Surface decoration: wall and ceiling tiles, flooring.c.Built-in furniture: built-in cabinets, counters (reception, bars, shops etc.)d.Special interior elements: radiator covers, cloakrooms etc.e.Space acoustics, acoustic interior elements.3.Teamwork and presentation. (allowance 0/6) a.Establishment of working Teams.b.Choice of topic area - e.g. interior elements, Technology in interior design, Smart technologies etc.c.Review of technical documents.d.Team presentation of the topic.4.Preparation of the semester project: PART 1. (allowance 0/9) a.Individual assignment of work, approval of the chosen interior element.b.Focus and photo documentation of the implemented interior element - (optional design).c.Simplified production documentation, visualization.d.Deliverables for downstream construction professions.e.Technical report.5.Preparation of the semester project: PART 2. (allowance 0/12) a.Budget - price calculation of the specified interior element (see PART 1.)b.Price Calculation for Interior.
